Avoid confusing dithering with halftone patterns; true dither uses fixed-size marks or pixels.
Do not equate generic pixel art with dithering; dithering is a tonal technique within pixel art.
Prevent over-smoothing; dithering relies on visible patterns and texture.
Use consistent palettes and mark types to maintain the intended style.
Check algorithm parameters to ensure the pattern does not become too random or too ordered for the selected style.
